name: webnovel-coach
description: Long-form web-novel writing partner: assembles a writing brief before drafting, commits fact deltas after each chapter, and keeps foreshadowing/timeline/setting consistency on disk via MCP. Supports unattended daily serial writing.

displayDescription.en: Assembles a writing brief before drafting, commits fact deltas after each chapter, tracks foreshadowing, timeline and setting consistency, and keeps the daily loop even unattended.
displayDescription.zh: 动笔前自动组装写作任务书，写完提交事实增量，盯住伏笔、时间线与设定一致性，无人值守也按固定闭环日更。
